subject: Changing borders in an rhandsontable programmatically

messages.author: 0da61c00e1a1be17
messages.subject: Changing borders in an rhandsontable programmatically
parts:
Hi all,
In the little code below, I like to be able to replace the number 2 in "row = 2" for example, by a reactive value (e.g. row$nb) so the borders are changed accordingly. I tried implementing it and it did not work. Only the initial value is considered, but the table is not updated with new values. Any idea as how this could be done?

Thanks 
    
output$grid2RRaw = renderRHandsontable({
      rhandsontable(dfra2RR$data,selectCallback = TRUE, width=350,height = 450,useTypes = TRUE,rowHeaders = TRUE) %>%
        hot_context_menu(allowColEdit = TRUE) %>%
        hot_table(customBorders = list(list(
          range = list(from = list(row = 1, col = 1),
                       to = list(row = 2, col = 1)),
          top = list(width = 2, color = "red"),
          left = list(width = 2, color = "red"),
          bottom = list(width = 2, color = "red"),
          right = list(width = 2, color = "red"))))
})
